title: Giant 3D Chess
description: A Resourcepack that adds Giant 3D Chess Pieces to minecraft
body:
A Resourcepack that adds Giant 3D Chess Pieces in minecraft 1.21. By renaming black and white dyes you can create giant chess pieces and put them on item frames to play chess with your friends

**make sure you play facing _NORTH_ as white pieces and _SOUTH_ as black pieces for the horse to be facing the right direction**
